title: zeia tenera
intro: Zeia tenera, commonly known as the "Sensitive Plant", is a climbing plant native to South America that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Zeia tenera include its ability to calm the nervous system and improve sleep quality, making it a popular remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Zeia tenera include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
